اقتضوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَوْا (iqtaḍaw) /iq.ta.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اُقْتُضُوا (uqtuḍū) /uq.tu.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اِقْتَضُوا (iqtaḍū) /iq.ta.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
